title: The Kirby band's arrangers, Charlie Shavers and Billy Kyle
summary: Shavers and Kyle made most of the Kirby arrangements, and Shavers wrote tunes like Undecided.

blocks.x: Well, the two arrangers for that band, you see, that made the majority of the arrangements were clean.
Who were the arrangers? Who were these two arrangers?
Charlie Shavers was a great arranger, which a lot of people don't know, you know. Even those little tunes he wrote, you know. 'Undecided --'
-- and a couple of others. Yeah. He was a very good arranger. I don't know as he ever wrote anything for Tommy when he was there but he should have.
